theme: On the water in Croatia — an open calendar, and Florida-trip bookings that need a dry-land hour.
greeting: You're mid-charter on the Adriatic with the girls back in Florida with Jen, so the calendar is clear. The real pull today is shore admin: a friend's note before he sails Saturday, and a stack of Florida-trip bookings that keep slipping.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: The p1 rental for Portland at Christmas is due today. Book a refundable full-size SUV out of PWM now while holiday inventory holds — the Pathfinder is south by then and there's no six-seater in Maine for the trip.

needsAttention.title: Florida car + St Pete gap
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20–Oct 5 full-size SUV at TPA still isn't booked, and the Sept 20–21 landing nights before Orlando are open. Confirm the Sept 27–Oct 5 St Pete Airbnb actually converted from pending, too.

needsAttention.title: Disembark logistics
needsAttention.detail: The Komolac→Cavtat transfer, a bag hold before 3 PM check-in, and the ~5:15 AM Sept 20 checkout for LH4297 all still need arranging from shore — much harder once you're back underway.

needsAttention.title: Reply to Philip
needsAttention.detail: Philip wrote wanting to get together and leaves Saturday for two weeks in the Med — a quick note back before he sails.

flagged.title: Philip wants to reconnect
flagged.detail: A personal note marked important; he leaves Saturday for a Med cruise, so a reply lands better before then.

inbox.noise: Everything else is newsletters and shopping — chocolates, Maine seafood, market notes, cooking, and sailing tips.

recipe.title: Pork chops with roasted beets & escarole salad
recipe.why: An early-autumn dish that leans on the last of the season's produce as the light shifts.

acts.line: A clear calendar on the water — the day is yours between legs of the charter.
If a signal window opens ashore, the Cavtat transfers and the Florida car are the highest-leverage calls.
A short reply to Philip closes the one personal thread before he sails Saturday.
